diet_strategy: Moderate overall caloric deficit (roughly 300-500 kcal/day) built from the phenotype plan above, not extreme restriction
Prioritise protein and fibre at every meal to stay full on fewer calories
Limit refined carbs and fried food; keep portion sizes of grains modest
exercise: Add 150+ min/week of moderate cardio (brisk walking, cycling) on top of the phenotype's exercise plan, as tolerated
Include 2x/week resistance training to preserve muscle while losing weight

diet_strategy: Do not restrict calories -- focus on nutrient density and meal regularity instead of weight loss
Ensure adequate healthy fats and protein at each meal to support hormone production
exercise: Favour moderate, restorative movement (yoga, walking, light strength work) over high-intensity or high-volume training, which can worsen lean-PCOS hormonal stress
